defect.summary: N07B chunks the frame into pages of 200 registration ids and N08 asks the HPD contacts dataset feu5-w2e2 for the contacts of all 200 in ONE request, with $limit=2000. Socrata's $limit is one PAGE, not a result-set ceiling: the server returns at most that many rows, says nothing about what it left behind, and the remainder is reachable only through $offset. Live HPD holds single registrations whose contact-row count exceeds that page on its own (8,688 rows for registration 911741, 2,325 for 911715), so one such registration exhausts the page and the other 199 registrations in that chunk come back with no contacts at all, behind a valid 2xx. Nothing errors.
defect.blast_radius: Strictly the DISCOVERY direction. A dropped organization produces no candidate, no ledger row and no burn; a partially framed one keeps portfolio_units >= 3 and non-empty operating_boros so it cannot reach the 3650-day cell. It is not the D4 class: N08 still emits one envelope per request and the run still reaches its terminal artifact. What it destroyed was the MEANING of the result -- an under-five cohort produced this way is indistinguishable from an honest one.

repair.part_1: $limit 2000 -> 50000, SODA v2's documented per-request maximum, from ONE named constant CONTACT_PAGE_CAP in clients/cohort-two-discovery/src/lib/shared.js. tools/build-workflow.js requires that module and builds the query parameter from it, and the N09 guard is rendered from the same block, so the number the query sends and the number the guard judges answers against are one definition rather than two literals that agree today.
repair.part_2: sodaRows gained a PER-ENVELOPE truncation sentry. After the json, array-body and 2xx-status checks -- in that order, so a full body behind a 503 is still contacts-response-status and is not renamed as a source problem -- a body that came back FULL throws `frame-source-truncated: <label> item <i> returned <n> rows against the <cap>-row page cap`.
repair.cap_argument: REQUIRED and un-defaultable (lesson #172). Exactly two accepted answers: a positive integer for a read that asked for one page, or an EXPLICIT null for a read the caller pages itself. N07 walks the frame by $offset from the cursor, so a full registrations page is the ordinary case and N07B passes null OUT LOUD rather than omitting the argument. Omitted, string, 0, negative, float, NaN, Infinity, boolean, object, array -> throws `<label>-page-cap-not-supplied`. The message uses typeof, never String(cap), so a Symbol cannot crash it.
repair.comparison: >= rather than ===. SODA cannot answer with more rows than the limit, so equality is the case that occurs, which is exactly why an equality test would never be observed failing if it were wrong. A body BELOW the cap, zero included, is a complete answer, so the D4 empty-page contract is untouched.
repair.pagination: NOT implemented, deliberately. If the sentry fires on a real run, that is the explicit trigger for a separately designed pagination change.
